_description: CAREER arm D 'ontfull': a SEEDED reproduction of the original results_v7_lc_*_ontology arm. Deliberately NOT single-factor — it moves all four things the old arm moved at once, because its purpose is to reproduce the reported +0.0226 at 10%, not to attribute it.
_note_on_the_matcher: With ontology_guided_negatives=false AND ontology_weight=0.0, BatchProcessor builds no skill matcher at all (it is gated on 'use_ontology or force_skill_negatives'). So this arm loads no ESCO graph and has no ontology signal anywhere — the esco_* paths below are inert and kept only so the two configs differ in as few lines as possible.
_comment_cache: Dedicated path, shared by BOTH career learning-curve arms. Text embeddings come from the FROZEN encoder, so they are identical across arms and the second arm reuses them for free; nothing arm-specific or learned is cached. It must not be the historical shared 'embedding_cache/text_embeddings.pt': that file predates v7, covers 0% of these content hashes, and writing v7 vectors back into it would grow a file other experiments depend on. Size is set well above the ~16k unique resume/job texts in frac_100 + validation so nothing is evicted; at 10000 the tail of frac_100 thrashes and the hit rate collapses.
_comment_the_factor: THE ONE THING THAT VARIES, here switched OFF.
_comment_skill_distances: Matched to the ontology arm so it cannot become a second factor. Inert here: this arm builds no skill matcher, so nothing reads it.
_why: Both single-factor arms came back null across 5/10/15/20% with 3 seeds each: negative selection pooled delta -0.0007 (t=-0.163, p=0.87), sample weighting +0.0039 (t=+0.933, p=0.37). Neither reproduces +0.0226. Two possibilities remain: the effect needs the mechanisms TOGETHER (interaction), or the original number was unseeded noise — plausible given per-cell sd of 0.015-0.024. This arm decides between them. If it is also null, the original +0.0226 was noise and no further decomposition is warranted.
_note_pathway: use_pathway_negatives is included for fidelity to the old arm, but note it is NOT a distinct mechanism: BatchProcessor builds self.career_graph when it is set, yet _select_negatives never consults it — after the gate, control goes to _select_ontology_negatives (the skill matcher) or to random. So pathway and ontology_guided_negatives open the same gate and run the same selection code.
